name: schedule_create
description: Define a repeating invoice: a client, the line items, how often to bill (weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly or every N days), when it starts and optionally when it ends. Nothing is invoiced until invoice_generate_due runs. Month steps keep the start date's day of month and clamp it to shorter months, so a schedule starting on the 31st bills on the 28th/29th in February and back on the 31st in March.

arguments.name: client
arguments.desc: Client name or id, as in the invoice server. Unknown names are created on the first generated invoice

arguments.name: items
arguments.desc: The line items billed every period

arguments.name: currency
arguments.desc: Defaults to your business default currency

arguments.name: every
arguments.desc: How often to bill: "weekly", "monthly", "quarterly", "yearly", or {days: 10}

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD. The first invoice falls on this date

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, INCLUSIVE: an occurrence landing exactly on it is still generated

arguments.name: due_days
arguments.desc: Days until each invoice is due, defaults to your payment terms

arguments.name: notes
arguments.desc: Free text printed under the totals of every generated invoice

arguments.name: auto_generate
arguments.desc: Marks the schedule for the monthly_billing_run prompt. Default false. Nothing runs in the background either way: invoices are created only when invoice_generate_due is called

arguments.name: anchor_day
arguments.desc: Pro: bill on this day of month instead of the start date's day. 31 means the last day of every month

arguments.name: end_of_month
arguments.desc: Pro: always bill on the last day of the month

name: schedule_list
description: Every schedule with its cadence, per-period amount, next due date and status (active or paused).

name: schedule_get
description: The full stored record for one schedule: items, cadence, dates, rules and how many invoices it has generated.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Schedule id, or a client name

name: schedule_update
description: Change a schedule's client, items, currency, cadence, dates, due days, notes or auto_generate flag. Periods already invoiced are never re-issued, so changing the amount affects future invoices only.

arguments.name: every
arguments.desc: How often to bill: "weekly", "monthly", "quarterly", "yearly", or {days: 10}

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: null clears the end date

arguments.name: anchor_day
arguments.desc: Pro

arguments.name: end_of_month
arguments.desc: Pro

name: schedule_pause
description: Stop a schedule from generating invoices without deleting it. Its history is kept and it can be resumed.

name: schedule_resume
description: Make a paused schedule active again. Periods that fell due while it was paused are still due and will be created by the next invoice_generate_due.

name: schedule_delete
description: Remove a schedule. Invoices it already generated stay in the invoice server untouched and its generation history is kept as an audit trail. Note that re-creating the same schedule afterwards gives it a NEW id, so its old periods count as unbilled again: invoice_generate_due will warn that another schedule for that client already covered them.

name: schedule_upcoming
description: Table of every schedule occurrence falling due in the next N days, with the amount per occurrence and the total per currency. Free covers 30 days.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Days ahead, default 30

name: invoice_generate_due
description: Create a real invoice in the invoice server for every schedule occurrence on or before as_of that has not been invoiced yet, and render each PDF. Idempotent: one invoice per schedule per period, keyed by the occurrence date, so running it twice creates nothing the second time. Reports what was created and what was skipped. Free and unlimited.

arguments.name: as_of
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today

arguments.name: schedule_id
arguments.desc: Only this schedule

arguments.name: dry_run
arguments.desc: List what would be created without creating anything. Default false

name: schedule_history
description: The audit log for one schedule: every period it has generated, the invoice number, dates, amount and PDF path.

name: forecast
description: Expected invoiced revenue per calendar month per currency from every active schedule. Free covers 3 months ahead; Pro covers up to 120.

arguments.name: months
arguments.desc: Months ahead including this one, default 12

name: license_status
description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

name: license_activate
description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: License key from the checkout confirmation page
